latest_release.body:
## v9.3.8

### Features

* desktop-apps: add OpenCloud connection provider by palchrb in [desktop-apps#42](https://github.com/Euro-Office/desktop-apps/pull/42)
* core: Android build by rikled in [core#182](https://github.com/Euro-Office/core/pull/182)
* core: Move the third-party remote cache to S3 (eo-build-assets) by rikled in [core#178](https://github.com/Euro-Office/core/pull/178)
* sdkjs: word: add selection statistics API by martivilella in [sdkjs#98](https://github.com/Euro-Office/sdkjs/pull/98)
* web-apps: documenteditor: show selection counts in the word count popup by martivilella in [web-apps#289](https://github.com/Euro-Office/web-apps/pull/289)

### Bug fixes

* DesktopEditors: ci: authenticate Inno language listing on Windows by juliusknorr in [DesktopEditors#187](https://github.com/Euro-Office/DesktopEditors/pull/187)
* desktop-apps: Build amd64 desktop on Rocky Linux 9 (fixes Euro-Office/DesktopEditors#122) by rikled in [desktop-apps#72](https://github.com/Euro-Office/desktop-apps/pull/72)
* desktop-apps: debian: add missing dependancies by ohvinx in [desktop-apps#86](https://github.com/Euro-Office/desktop-apps/pull/86)
* desktop-apps: follow the system display language when no language is set by bargib in [desktop-apps#83](https://github.com/Euro-Office/desktop-apps/pull/83)
* desktop-apps: linux: missing icons at recent files feature of startpage by alexanderwwagner in [desktop-apps#85](https://github.com/Euro-Office/desktop-apps/pull/85)
* desktop-apps: Show Catalan in its native name in the language list by atmarc in [desktop-apps#81](https://github.com/Euro-Office/desktop-apps/pull/81)
* desktop-apps: settings: stop showing the NEW badge on the AI setting by bargib in [desktop-apps#54](https://github.com/Euro-Office/desktop-apps/pull/54)
* desktop-apps: win: use own ProgIDs so ONLYOFFICE stays in "Open with" by rikled in [desktop-apps#100](https://github.com/Euro-Office/desktop-apps/pull/100)
* desktop-apps: linux: stop packaging offline help by default by rikled in [desktop-apps#99](https://github.com/Euro-Office/desktop-apps/pull/99)
* desktop-apps: inno: associate template file types by rikled in [desktop-apps#98](https://github.com/Euro-Office/desktop-apps/pull/98)
* desktop-apps: inno: don't abort setup on stale Windows Installer data by rikled in [desktop-apps#97](https://github.com/Euro-Office/desktop-apps/pull/97)
* desktop-apps: win: ship Qt's FFmpeg DLLs so media playback works (stable-9.3.8) by rikled in [desktop-apps#114](https://github.com/Euro-Office/desktop-apps/pull/114)
* desktop-sdk: crash when playing embedded videos (Qt6) by rikled in [desktop-sdk#21](https://github.com/Euro-Office/desktop-sdk/pull/21)
* desktop-sdk: wayland: blank presentation tab after leaving slideshow by rikled in [desktop-sdk#22](https://github.com/Euro-Office/desktop-sdk/pull/22)
* desktop-sdk: drop zlib addon flag removed from core by rikled in [desktop-sdk#25](https://github.com/Euro-Office/desktop-sdk/pull/25)
* desktop-sdk: wayland: paste from system clipboard in login windows by rikled in [desktop-sdk#23](https://github.com/Euro-Office/desktop-sdk/pull/23)
* desktop-sdk: win: show Qt media player above the CEF browser window (stable-9.3.8) by rikled in [desktop-sdk#37](https://github.com/Euro-Office/desktop-sdk/pull/37)
* desktop-sdk: wayland: type the character the keyboard layout produces (stable-9.3.8) by rikled in [desktop-sdk#41](https://github.com/Euro-Office/desktop-sdk/pull/41)
* desktop-sdk: wayland: media player drawn offset and scaled twice (stable-9.3.8) by rikled in [desktop-sdk#47](https://github.com/Euro-Office/desktop-sdk/pull/47)
* desktop-sdk: linux: hide media player when its tab is hidden (stable-9.3.8) by rikled in [desktop-sdk#48](https://github.com/Euro-Office/desktop-sdk/pull/48)
* core: Build amd64 desktop on Rocky Linux 9 (fixes Euro-Office/DesktopEditors#122) by rikled in [core#165](https://github.com/Euro-Office/core/pull/165)
* core: make zlib a 3r

## Welcome to the Desktop Editors repo!

[Desktop Editors](https://github.com/Euro-Office/DesktopEditors) is a free office suite that combines text, spreadsheet, presentation, and PDF editors & Diagram Viewer. The application allows creating, viewing and editing documents stored on your Windows/Linux PC or Mac without an Internet connection. It is fully compatible with Office Open XML formats: .docx, .xlsx, .pptx.

## Features you'll love ✨

Take advantage of the powerful editors included in Desktop Editors.

* Document Editor
* Spreadsheet Editor
* Presentation Editor
* Form Creator
* PDF Editor
* Diagram Viewer

The suite empowers you to create, edit, save, and export text documents, spreadsheets, presentations, PDFs, fill out PDF forms, open diagrams, all while offering additional advanced features such as:

* Connection to the cloud (Moodle, Nextcloud, ownCloud, Seafile, Liferay, kDrive) for real-time collaboration ☁️
* AI-powered assistants 🤖
* Digital signatures ✍️🔏
* Password protection 🔒🔑
* Scalable UI options (including dark mode 🌓)

## Localization 🌐

Constantly improving localization of the editors to make the suite accessible to all users, all over the world.

* Interface available in 46 languages
* RTL support
* Hieroglyph support 🈴

## Plugins 🧩

Desktop Editors offer support for plugins allowing developers to add specific features to the editors that are not directly related to the OOXML format.

## Components 📦

Desktop Editors contain the following components:

* [desktop-apps](https://github.com/Euro-Office/desktop-apps) - the frontend for Desktop Editors which is used to build the program interface for the operating system selected.
* [desktop-sdk](https://github.com/Euro-Office/desktop-sdk) - SDK which is a core part of Desktop Editors.
* [core](https://github.com/Euro-Office/core) - server core components for [Document Server][1] which is a part of Desktop Editors and is used to enable the conversion between the most popular office document formats (DOC, DOCX, ODT, RTF, TXT, PDF, HTML, EPUB, XPS, DjVu, XLS, XLSX, ODS, CSV, PPT, PPTX, ODP).
* [sdkjs](https://github.com/Euro-Office/sdkjs) - JavaScript SDK for the [Document Server][1] which is a part of Desktop Editors and contains API for all the included components client-side interaction.
* [web-apps](https://github.com/Euro-Office/web-apps) - the frontend for [Document Server][1] which is a part of Desktop Editors that allows the user to create, edit, save and export text, spreadsheet and presentation documents using the common interface of a document editor.
* [dictionaries](https://github.com/Euro-Office/dictionaries) - the dictionaries of various languages used for spellchecking in Desktop Editors.

## Install 💾

Signed builds are available as **Nextcloud Office**, which also offers APT and DNF package repositories. Unsigned community builds are published on the [releases](https://github.com/Euro-Office/DesktopEditors/releases/latest) page of this repository.

[Download Nextcloud Office Desktop Editors](https://github.com/nextcloud-releases/Office-DesktopEditors/releases/latest)

See the [installation guide](https://euro-office.github.io/documentation/installation/) in the [official documentation](https://euro-office.github.io/documentation/) for details.

## Build it yourself 🛠️

You can build Desktop Editors from source on **Windows**, **Linux**, and **macOS**. This is a
super-repository, so the first step is always to check out the submodules:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/Euro-Office/DesktopEditors.git
cd DesktopEditors
git submodule update --init --recursive
```

Then head to the build docs:

* **[build/](./build/README.md)** — start here for the overall build model (the
  shared CMake definition, the common editors payload, vcpkg, and caching).
* **[build/windows/](./build/windows/README.md)** — the Windows build (`build.ps1`, MSVC + CMake).
* **[build/linux/](./build/linux/README.md)** — the Linux build (Docker / `docker buildx bake`).
* **[build/macos/](./build/macos/README.md)** — the macOS build (native CMake + Xcode).

## Get involved 🤝

Contributions are welcome! Whether it's a bug report, a feature idea, a
translation, or a pull request, here's how to take part:

* **Found a bug or have an idea?** Open an [issue](https://github.com/Euro-Office/DesktopEditors/issues)
  and describe what you ran into or what you'd like to see.
* **Want to contribute code?** Fork the relevant [component](#components-) repo,
  make your change, and open a pull request. For build changes, see the
  [build docs](./build/README.md) above.
* **Want to help translate?** Localization improvements are always appreciated —
  see 
  the editors' interface translations.

Please keep contributions compatible with the project's AGPL v3 license.
